notes: «حدثنا أبي» is a bare relation (father of يعقوب), not named in the text.
The Syrian in «سمع رجلا، من أهل الشام» is in the scene only. عبد الله بن عمر is the answerer, so he is the last link; occurrence 2 is the answer, occurrence 1 is the question.
Tirmidhi's own remarks after the report carry no isnad and are not read.
